enrichment.short_title: Section 459 petition not struck out for delay
key_facts: Mr Hateley held 25% of Legal Costs Negotiators Ltd alongside three co-shareholders in an admitted quasi-partnership.

enrichment.short_title: Article 81 defence allowed on damages assessment

key_facts: Bim Kemi and Blackburn Chemicals disputed a 1994 distribution agreement for antifoam products after Blackburn stopped supplies in December 1998.

key_facts: Mr Strauss sought to enfranchise 21 Cheyne Walk under leases dated 12 April 1983 for the house and garden.

enrichment.short_title: VAT relief on terminated car hire purchase
key_facts: GMAC supplies Vauxhall cars on hire purchase and accounts for VAT upfront on the full sale price when the hirer takes possession.

Clause 9 of GMAC's standard conditions reduces the hirer's liability by resale proceeds after repossession for breach.
